words.meaning: First aorist active indicative of anakuptw, the opposite of katakuptw, to bend down (verse #8) or of katw kuptw (verse #6). (Robertson's NT Word Pictures)
words.plain: He lifted himself up [Greek: anekupsen, the opposite of bending down] — Jesus had been bent over, writing in the dust. Now he straightens up and looks directly at the accusers. The physical gesture matches the weight of what he's about to say: a shift from silence to direct confrontation.
